item.title: Zucchini Scrambled Eggs
item.description: These scrambled eggs are flavored with salsa and Cheddar cheese and as a bonus, they're another way you can sneak more zucchini into your meals.

item.title: Whole Wheat Banana Waffles
item.description: In this whole wheat banana waffles recipe, transform your overripe bananas into banana waffles made with whole wheat flour for a hearty start to the day.

item.title: Turkey Spinach Sweet Potato Casserole
item.description: Make this sweet potato casserole ahead of time for a satisfying breakfast with layers of turkey sausage, spinach, and seasoned egg whites.

item.title: Three Cheese Salami Frittata
item.description: This three cheese salami frittata is cut into small squares and can be served as a delightful appetizer alongside a nice glass of white wine.

item.title: Spiced Pumpkin Bread
item.description: Buttery pumpkin bread nicely spiced with warm cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg is a festive treat for any occasion.

item.title: Spiced Apple Topping for Pancakes
item.description: Full of fall flavor, this apple topping for pancakes can double as a dessert if served with ice cream or Greek yogurt.

item.title: Sheet Pan Pancakes
item.description: These sheet pan pancakes are a breeze to make and will be ready for the whole family at the same time, and nobody has to stand over a hot stove!

item.title: Sheet Pan Breakfast Bake
item.description: A layered breakfast bake with two ingredient dough, eggs, and bacon.

item.title: Rosemary, Bacon, and Tomato Frittata
item.description: Rosemary, bacon, and tomato frittata is a colorful and savory dish to serve on weekend mornings or for holiday brunches.

item.title: Pumpkin French Toast
item.description: Kids won't even notice the whole wheat bread in this cinnamon- and nutmeg-flavored six-ingredient pumpkin French toast recipe with canned pumpkin purée.

item.title: Poached Eggs and Asparagus
item.description: Tender asparagus, poached eggs, and toast make an elegant breakfast for four. Add ham or Canadian bacon, if desired.

item.title: Overnight Blueberry French Toast Casserole
item.description: Impress your family and friends with this overnight blueberry French toast casserole recipe with juicy berries and a sweet cream cheese filling.

item.title: Morning Bruschetta
item.description: Crunchy slices of Italian bread are topped with eggs baked with tomatoes, basil, and Parmesan cheese to make these clever morning bruschetta.

item.title: Monster Cookie Pancakes
item.description: What's better than pancakes for breakfast? Monster cookie-inspired pancakes! This recipe has peanut butter and 2 kinds of chocolate treats.

item.title: Mini Bacon Quiche Muffins
item.description: Wrapped in crispy, oven-fried bacon, these mini spinach and Cheddar quiche muffins are a nice choice for breakfast or brunch.

item.title: Milk-Free Fluffy Pancakes
item.description: Coconut milk is the milk-replacement in this quick and easy recipe for fluffy breakfast pancakes.

item.title: Microwave Blueberry Dutch Baby
item.description: A fluffy 'Dutch baby' casserole is ready in less than 30 minutes by cooking in the microwave for a quick and easy brunch dish.

item.title: Mexican Fiesta Breakfast Casserole
item.description: This Mexican-inspired breakfast casserole combines beans, tomatoes, chiles, and chorizo for a flavorful mixture that the entire family will love.

item.title: Instant Pot French Toast Casserole
item.description: This classic French toast recipe is super easy in the Instant Pot. It uses the pot-in-pot method, so have a small baking pan and trivet ready. Serve with fruit and syrup.

item.title: Huevos Rancheros Frittata
item.description: This tasty Mexican-style frittata based on huevos rancheros is quick and easy to make with salsa, onion, sour cream, and cilantro.

item.title: Homemade Vegan Coconut Yogurt
item.description: A vegan concoction of coconut milk, agar-agar, and probiotic powder, this homemade yogurt is easy to customize using whatever you have on hand.

item.title: Holiday Breakfast Casserole with Biscuits and Bacon
item.description: This savory breakfast casserole with biscuits and bacon is perfect for Christmas morning, and can be ready even faster if you make the potatoes and bacon the night before!

item.title: Glazed Pumpkin Spice Doughnuts
item.description: These pumpkin spice doughnuts are baked in the oven and sweetened with a pumpkin pie spice-flavored glaze.

item.title: German Pear Pancake
item.description: The German-style pear pancake recipe calls for baking the pancake in a cast-iron skillet for a fluffy breakfast or brunch treat. Serve it with maple syrup.

item.title: French Toast Pan-Fried Tofu (Gluten Free)
item.description: In this recipe, tofu is dipped in cornmeal and cinnamon then pan-fried into a quick, gluten free alternative to French toast. You'll love it for breakfast.

item.title: Double Chocolate Pancakes
item.description: These rich but fluffy chocolate pancakes with chocolate chips are a decadent way to start the morning.

item.title: Diabetic-Friendly Coconut Muffins
item.description: Just a little sugar and flaked coconut add their sweetness to muffins made with low-fat yogurt.

item.title: Dad's Kentucky Home Fries
item.description: Golden-brown fried potatoes made with bacon drippings and sweet Vidalia® onion. Leftovers keep well in the fridge for a microwave breakfast on the go. For an East Coast twist, add diced green pepper.

item.title: Chef John's Baked Eggs
item.description: Chef John's baked eggs recipe features a spicy marinara sauce that mingles with just barely set eggs and tops them with cream and Parmigiano-Reggiano.

item.title: Butternut Squash Fritters
item.description: Try these butternut squash fritters if you want to skip the starch of potato pancakes. Starting with frozen butternut squash spirals makes prep a breeze.

item.title: Bread Pudding Muffins
item.description: Enjoy the comforting taste of bread pudding in the form of a muffin with this easy recipe that's great for breakfast or dessert.

item.title: AIP Breakfast Tapioca Porridge (Grain Free and Paleo)
item.description: This tapioca porridge flavored with coconut milk and a raspberry-rhubarb sauce is gluten-free, paleo- and AIP-friendly, and it tastes great!

item.title: Oatmeal Scotchie Pancakes
item.description: What's better than pancakes for breakfast? Oatmeal scotchie cookie-inspired pancakes! Try this recipe featuring oats and butterscotch chips.

item.title: Milk Toast
item.description: This old-fashioned breakfast recipe for milk toast combines bite-sized toasted white bread pieces served in a bowl of sweetened, vanilla-flavored milk.

item.title: Low-Fat Breakfast Muffins
item.description: Made with applesauce, skim milk, and egg whites, these low-fat muffins are a great portable breakfast that are both adult and kid friendly.

item.title: Whole Grain Breakfast Cookies Recipe
item.description: Breakfast cookies made with whole grains like rolled oats, flax meal, and whole wheat flour have the flavor of dried cherries and chocolate chips for a tasty breakfast on the run.

item.title: Easy Crustless Quiche
item.description: This crustless quiche made with eggs, cream, and crispy bacon is a fuss-free, low-carb meal that's easy to customize with your favorite cheese.

item.title: Crustless Spinach Quiche
item.description: This crustless quiche made with eggs, spinach, and Muenster cheese is quick and easy to bake in just 30 minutes for a delicious breakfast or brunch.

item.title: Quick Quiche
item.description: This quick quiche is a crustless version of the classic baked custard made with Swiss cheese, milk, and eggs for a no-fuss, stress-free breakfast.

item.title: Cheesy Rice and Zucchini Frittata
item.description: Havarti and Parmesan cheeses are a pleasing combination in this cheesy zucchini frittata that's simple to whip up and a satisfying addition to brunch, lunch, or dinner.

item.title: Quinoa Breakfast Pudding
item.description: Tender quinoa is simmered with apple juice, raisins, and lemon juice and spiced with cinnamon and vanilla and served warm.

item.title: Air Fryer Crescent Breakfast Pockets
item.description: These breakfast pockets made with crescent roll dough are easy to make in your air fryer, and the filling can be adjusted to your personal taste.

item.title: Healthy, Kid-Friendly Banana Bread
item.description: Instead of using white sugar in banana bread, this recipe uses maple syrup, applesauce, and Greek yogurt and transforms overripe bananas into a moist, kid-friendly banana bread.

item.title: Make-Ahead Air Fryer Breakfast Burritos
item.description: Sausage, egg, and cheese burritos made ahead of time that you can grab out of the freezer, pop in the air fryer, and be on your way in no time.

item.title: Sausage Hash With Apples & Sage
item.description: Hash makes a fast brunch or even light supper dish. This variation is made with Italian sausage, onion, and a potato and apple mixture, and is seasoned with parsley and sage.

item.title: Rice Breakfast Bars
item.description: Gluten-free rice breakfast bars are packed with nutrition, lightly sweetened with honey, and include currants, peanut butter, and garbanzo bean flour.

item.title: Sweet Potato Breakfast Casserole
item.description: Vegetarian sweet potato casserole with eggs, cheese, and vegetarian sausage on a bed of buttery shredded sweet potatoes makes a hearty breakfast!

item.title: Bacon Pancakes
item.description: These bacon pancakes are the sweet-salty combo that will start your day out right. It's a breakfast all in one, with plenty of bacon in every bite.

item.title: The Denver Omelet
item.description: This Denver omelet is Chef John's version of beaten eggs firmly cooked and filled with green bell pepper, smoked ham, onions, and Cheddar cheese.

item.title: Easy Breakfast Egg Muffins
item.description: These breakfast egg muffins with cheese, bell peppers, and bacon can be customized to your tastes and made ahead for a yummy on-the-go morning meal.

item.title: The Legendary Egg Dog
item.description: The "legendary egg dog" combines eggs and hot dog buns. A cooked egg is placed in a hot dog bun and topped with hot sauce for a quick, fun breakfast.

item.title: Vegetarian Breakfast Casserole with Hash Browns
item.description: This vegetarian breakfast casserole has a crispy crust of hash browns under a delicious mixture of eggs, vegetarian sausage, cheese, and vegetables.

item.title: Chef John's Cloud Eggs
item.description: Egg whites whisked like meringue, then baked into puffy clouds, are best served on top of buttery, toasted bread for a fun take on a breakfast classic.

item.title: Patty Pan Frittata
item.description: Patty pan squash joins chorizo sausage, goat cheese, and Parmesan in this fun recipe for mini breakfast frittatas.

item.title: Spicy Breakfast Quesadillas
item.description: These breakfast quesadillas made with spicy pork sausage and nacho cheese are sure to start your day with a bang!

item.title: Vegetable Frittata with Cheddar
item.description: This frittata with Cheddar cheese includes lots of veggies like broccoli, cauliflower, and carrots and is low in carbohydrates.

item.title: Pumpkin Cream Cold Brew
item.description: Pumpkin cream cold brew can be easily made at home in the fall; just make your own pumpkin cream from scratch!

item.title: Down-Home Country Breakfast Gravy
item.description: Brown gravy with bits of savory bacon tastes great served over warm biscuits for a hearty Southern breakfast.

item.title: Mexican Chorizo Breakfast Casserole
item.description: Switch up the breakfast casserole routine with this Mexican-inspired version with chorizo, charred poblanos, and cheese.
